_: Voice catalog. A voice is installed when data/voice/<id>/ holds ref.wav + ref.txt (see tools/add_voice.py). This repo ships NO cloned human voices: the entries below are either synthetic child voices generated from a text description, or a placeholder for a recording you make yourself. Add your own entries here. gender = m/f; accent = us/uk/other; age: child marks a synthetic child voice.
_cast: cast_order = preference order when assigning voices to characters (library/speech.py). Empty by default: fill it with your own voice ids, best first.
